note: Dimensional vocabulary for demos/racetrack: per-asset bounding-box decompositions and the placement statistics the rules read. Measurements of objects, not the objects. No level layout and no source identifiers — see scripts/gen-racetrack-vocabulary.mjs.

units.axes: across (right of travel), along (racing direction), up (surface normal)
units.origin: each asset's own bounds centre; boxes are relative to it
